description:
The exact escrowed MCP tarball is published once through protected tokenless OIDC after final-tag completion.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The npm workflow authenticates final-tag completion and escrow identity, enters the constant publication mutex before live read, writes prepared evidence, and invokes the pure direct-publish interface on the exact retained tarball with id-token permission and no npm token.
- [hard] REQ-02: Exact registry integrity and provenance readback precede completion; recovery reconciles matching live state from tag and escrow after Actions-410 without repack or source-directory publication.
- [hard] REQ-03: Fixtures reject pre-tag publish, wrong environment/package/tarball/integrity, token use, concurrent mutation, stale evidence, and conflicting registry state.

## Notes

Blast radius: npm publication/recovery workflow YAML and cross-workflow fixtures only.
title: Implement npm publication and recovery workflows
